answer.rationale: memory_b2 shows regional failover restored latency fast during March degradation with clean traffic shift and error rate recovery within minutes—directly relevant to a primary-region write latency spike at peak settlement. memory_b5 demonstrates routing dashboard queries to read replicas recovered transactional write latency the same day—provides a less disruptive interim step if failover proves risky under heavy write load. Combining these precedents supports choosing regional_failover as the primary intervention while keeping read-replica routing as a fallback if the failover creates write contention.
